title: WorkPulse performance.goal_completed v1
description: An active employee goal was completed. Identifiers and the state only — goal titles and descriptions are sensitive and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the goal belongs to — the subject (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

status.description: Terminal goal state; a completed goal is never re-opened.
